parts:
Hi Phil,

Wondering what is needed to get lr.random functional for mixedmirt(). I think I misinterpreted what the "random" argument does, and really I think I want what lr.random will do; didn't realize that it wasn't implemented yet (oops).

Thanks!
Carl

A lot of elbow grease and head-banging. This isn't implemented because I mainly want to generalize the form for multidimensional multilevel IRT models, which is rather complicated and difficult to track (lots of moving pieces). There's a lot of internal work that needs to be done, including a proper interface to specify this, so it's no trivial task. It's on my todo list, but it's not a high priority at the moment.
